fixes: FISA 702 sunset updated: the April 20, 2026 sunset passed; Congress extended it only to June 12, 2026 (S. 4465, P.L. 119-87); a further extension (H.R. 9238) failed in the House on June 11
edits: The sunset is April 20, 2026 — they will try it again.

The sunset was April 20, 2026. Congress passed a short extension to June 12 ([S. 4465](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/4465)); a further extension ([H.R. 9238](https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/9238)) failed in the House on June 11. They will try it again.
